item.title: Said & Checked, Economy and Jobs, 2026-11-18: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Tim Walberg)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Tim Walberg, U.S. Representative from Michigan: “Fishing in the Great Lakes alone contributes more than $5 billion to the regional economy and supports over 75,000 jobs.” Unsettled. A Great Lakes Fishery Commission study puts recreational fishing's economic output at $5.1 billion (reported by Michigan Public), matching the dollar figure. The commission's factsheet reportedly counts about 35,800 recreational and nearly 3,000 commercial jobs, about 39,000 in all, short of 75,000; that factsheet could not be read directly, so the jobs figure is not settled here.

8 statements by 6 officeholders. 2 checked: 1 supported, 1 unsettled · 5 not yet checked · 1 not checkable.
